UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and persisted subscription tier settings.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified email address from Firebase Auth token.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the account menu.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile or tier update.

SavedPhoneLookup.title: SavedPhoneLookup
SavedPhoneLookup.description: Saved reverse phone OSINT lookup summary belonging to a user.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who saved this phone lookup.

phoneNumber.description: Normalized phone number in E.164 or digit format.

formattedNational.description: Formatted display representation of the phone number.

spamScore.description: Composite spam risk score from 0 to 100.

subscriberPreview.description: Subscriber label or redaction notice based on user tier.

webSummary.description: Optional live web OSINT excerpt captured by the user.

savedAt.description: Server timestamp when the lookup was saved.

SavedAlprAudit.title: SavedAlprAudit
SavedAlprAudit.description: Saved Flock Safety & ALPR vehicle audit snapshot belonging to a user.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who saved this vehicle audit.

overallStatus.description: Whether active agency queries were logged.

detections30Days.description: Recorded ALPR camera detections over the past 30 days.

activeQueriesCount.description: Number of active law enforcement query records.

lastLocation.description: Most recent recorded camera intersection or corridor.

savedAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit was saved.

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: Monitored phone number or license plate tracked in the user's watchlist.

ownerId.description: UID of the user monitoring this target.

targetValue.description: Monitored phone number or license plate string.

jurisdictionState.description: Two-letter state code for plate targets, or empty string for phone numbers.

label.description: User-provided note or case label for the watched target.

lastStatus.description: Latest observed risk tier or ALPR surveillance status.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the watchlist entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the watchlist entry was last checked or renamed.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's profile and persisted subscription tier.

/users/{userId}/phoneLookups/{lookupId}.description: Stores saved reverse phone OSINT lookups for the owning user.

/users/{userId}/alprAudits/{auditId}.description: Stores saved Flock Safety and ALPR plate audits for the owning user.

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{itemId}.description: Stores monitored phone numbers and license plates in the user's watchlist.
